liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this third-ever Eyes winds through several themes, including Solomon's, and is especially impressive; Reviewer praises Bobby's tasteful playing in this early Eyes Of The World [8][10]
- **Jam** (1 review): Reviewer calls the jam after Truckin' stunning, even shocking, and says it must be heard [5]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Other One among the best versions they have ever heard [6]
- **China Doll** (1 review): After nearly twenty minutes of Eyes, Jerry winds it down into China Doll [8]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer, at their first Dead show, found Sugar Magnolia a perfect moment [14]
- Box Of Rain made the homesick Chicago reviewer feel back home, moving them to tears of joy [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil & Billy**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd73-02-19.set2sbd.fink.15589.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 87 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the sound quality as great; Good sound overall, but an unfortunate cut interrupts the jam leading into Eyes Of The World [6][7]
- **gd1973-02-19.set2.sbd.miller.83023.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 86 min; rated 4.42/5 by 19 [2]. Said about its sound: Minor azimuth issues before the tape flip; sound improves afterward [2]
- **gd1973-02-19.sbd.jim.jeffrey.12826.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 5 songs; 70 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls the Amphitheatre as old and stockyards-dirty, with a rowdy crowd throwing rocks through the skylights [12]
- Reviewer calls the Amphitheater a dump with character; cattle could be heard outside the doors [14]
- Tape flip falls between The Other One and Eyes Of The World, yet set two is seamless [2]
- Reviewer rates this show good but below disc three of the 5/26/73 show [4]
- Reviewer considers this one of the best second sets of 1973, with tasty jams throughout [6]
- Reviewer says the shows from Maples through this one are all worth having [7]
- Reviewer likens Bobby's approach here to his playing in the 02/09/73 Eyes [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-02-19.set2sbd.fink.15589.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer found the He's Gone through China Doll sequence on a cassette from Bear; Reviewer notes this two-CD circulating copy is incomplete, containing only part of the show; Lineage runs MC > C > DAT > SS > CDR > EAC > SHN, extracted and encoded by Alan J Fink [1][5][8]
- **gd1973-02-19.set2.sbd.miller.83023.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Ampex C-90) -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Transferred from a DAT from Steve Rolfe; tuning track patched in from shnid 15589 [2]
- **gd1973-02-19.sbd.jim.jeffrey.12826.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by jim@juddcreek; source: SBD>MC>C>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [3]
